nombre: Instant DXF quote widget for laser shops
cliente_que_paga: Owner of a laser/waterjet cutting shop
problema: Shops lose RFQs because quoting DXF files by hand takes hours.
solucion: Embeddable widget that parses DXF, computes cut length/pierces/material and returns an instant price.
canal_primeros_100: Shopify/WordPress plugin listings plus r/lasercutting and Facebook laser-shop groups
ventaja_juan: Knows DXF geometry and nesting costs from CAD/CAM work.
riesgo_principal: Shops fear exposing pricing and need setup effort.

nombre: STEP/IGES to glTF conversion API
cliente_que_paga: SaaS developers building manufacturing or e-commerce tools
problema: Rendering CAD in the browser needs heavy OpenCascade tooling.
solucion: Pay-per-use REST API converting STEP/IGES/DXF to glTF/PNG/SVG with thumbnails.
canal_primeros_100: SEO for 'step to gltf api', RapidAPI/API directories, GitHub examples
por_que_ahora: Web 3D viewers and parts marketplaces are growing.
ventaja_juan: Strong CAD format knowledge and backend skills.
riesgo_principal: Incumbent CAD SDK vendors could undercut.

nombre: Automated DFM checker for sheet metal
cliente_que_paga: Mechanical design engineers and startups ordering sheet-metal parts
problema: Parts get rejected by shops for min-flange, hole-to-edge or bend-relief errors.
solucion: Upload DXF/STEP and get a DFM report with highlighted violations by process.
canal_primeros_100: SEO 'sheet metal DFM checklist', r/engineering, Fusion/SolidWorks forums
competidores: Xometry and Protolabs built-in DFM (only on their quotes)
riesgo_principal: Quote platforms offer free DFM feedback (F1 risk).

nombre: Laser cut nesting and cost calculator for Etsy sellers

ventaja_juan: Knows laser time and cost models.
riesgo_principal: Low price needs many payers (F5 borderline).
